items.name: eva-badge
items.title: Eva Badge
items.description: Content-sized interface labels whose frame grows around one or two text levels.
items.docs: EvaBadge derives its width and height from the rendered labels, typography, padding, gap, rule, and border. The wider text level sets the frame width, so adding a shorter secondary label only adds height. Layout treats the badge as one atomic item. When its container is narrower than its intrinsic width, the complete badge scales proportionally instead of compressing individual parts. Use className and style for the atomic layout shell; use frameClassName and frameStyle for the visible badge. Use size for coordinated defaults, or override fontSize, secondaryFontSize, paddingInline, paddingBlock, gap, borderWidth, cornerRadius, and separatorThickness. horizontalScale changes both the visible type and measured frame width.

items.name: eva-text
items.title: Eva Text
items.description: Display typography with Evangelion-inspired font roles, tracking, and horizontal scaling.
items.docs: Horizontal scaling changes the rendered shape without changing layout width. Use it for headings and labels, not body-copy wrapping.
